content:
The run failed due to a formatting mismatch in the summary report where currency values lacked required comma separators.
The verifier failed in test_summary_requirements at /tests/test_outputs.py:165 with an AssertionError. Specifically, the test expected the formatted string '-455,619.31' (with commas) but found '-455619.31' in the OUTPUT_SUMMARY text. While the logic for calculating margins and selecting the 'move_to_14_day' recommendation was correct, the summary generation failed to apply standard USD thousand-separator formatting.
